answer: Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. A submitter whose answers share 3 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 34% of its pending payouts meanwhile. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
